'''Denab''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the planet was the site of a malfunctioning [[Denab Rakatan device|device]] built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that began generating new species of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Survival of the Strangest}}</ref> 

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the site where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Grisserno]] defeated the [[Imperial Fourth Attack Squadron]], composed of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], at the [[Battle of Denab]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Sluis Sector and, consequently, Denab, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].
